title: sgx-psw: 2.27 -> 2.29; nixos/aesmd: update
structural_notes: Diff restructures options.services.aesmd.settings from an mkOption{type=types.submodule{...}} wrapper to a plain nested options attrset (options.services.aesmd.settings = {proxy=mkOption{...}; proxyType=mkOption{...}; defaultQuotingType=mkOption{...}; qplLogLevel=mkOption{...};}); defaultQuotingType's enum type is also narrowed (drops epid_linkable/epid_unlinkable). whitelistUrl's mkOption declaration is deleted and replaced with a mkRemovedOptionModule entry. Watched: enable (baseline) + settings.proxy, settings.proxyType, settings.defaultQuotingType, settings.qplLogLevel (all touched mkOption declaration lines) + settings.whitelistUrl (touched via its mkOption removal / mkRemovedOptionModule addition).
